theme: Herd local development and milestone tooling
summary: Behind-the-scenes work: developers now run APES Newsroom on Laravel Herd, releases are named and checked by their milestone version, and deploys ship a published release tag. Nothing changes in how readers, subscribers or staff use the site.
detailed_changes: Local development moves from Laragon to Laravel Herd: the site runs at http://apes-newsroom.test on PHP 8.4 with its own database, local mail is caught by Herd, and a one-step setup script and a live preview check replace the Laragon ones (#803, superseding the Laragon checks in #759 and #761).

Milestone version tooling: composer milestone:* commands print the next milestone's version, branch, pull request title and release title, and a CI check rejects branch names and titles that use a GitHub milestone number or the wrong version (#757).

Ship once per milestone: one branch and one merge per milestone, releases titled from their milestone, and the Cloudron deploy workflow ships only a release tag on main with a published GitHub Release, with faster cached builds (#763).
Security checks use GitHub's free features: Dependabot updates go to a dependencies branch, and dependency review and CodeQL run on pull requests (#763).
The health endpoint reports the checked-out revision and PHP version only when running locally, for the developer preview; production responses are unchanged (#763).
affected_areas: Page or route: none (developer tooling, CI and deploy workflow)
Internal impact: local development, release naming, CI checks and the deploy workflow
